formal_target.decoder: G_F(b) returns Y with F(Y,b)=1 whenever I_F(b)=1
required_candidate_bounds: no assignment enumeration in candidate path
no DPLL/backtracking/exact_search/ROBDD/DP fallback in candidate path

candidate_language.name: BOUNDED_EXACT_PROJECTION_INTERFACE_K4
candidate_language.rule: Eliminate only internal variables whose complete non-tautological Davis-Putnam resolvent set stays at clause width <=4; every generated resolvent is charged and preserved. If no safe next internal variable exists before all internal variables are eliminated, return OPEN. No truncation of required resolvents is permitted.
candidate_language.elimination_order: At each step choose among safe internal variables by minimum (#positive clauses * #negative clauses), then variable id.
candidate_language.decoder: Store eliminated positive/negative parent clauses and reconstruct variables in reverse order by checking the two local truth values only after a bridge assignment has been supplied. This is reconstruction, not recursive search.
candidate_language.claim_ceiling: A successful projection is an exact scoped interface for that frame; failure is OPEN and does not falsify the reference-frame model. Fixed width 4 is explicitly not claimed universal after R8B.

independent_witness.procedure: For each frozen bridge assignment, restrict the original frame and use the independent exact DPLL verifier to decide whether an internal extension exists. Compare this exact truth table with any candidate interface emitted before the witness is read.
